description: Issue #196, profile-contract.md §10.2: a boolean key declared as the STRING "true" is refused. This is the shape a type check must catch rather than coerce — `Boolean("false")` is true, so a coercing loader would read a profile that says off as a profile that says on, and arm every worker this run sends. `load_error` / exit 6, at profile load.

error_details_include: profile.dispatch_defaults.auto_yes must be true or false, got "true"
